retry_scope.ruling: Contract v2.1 is silent on retry treatment. Operator ruled: the SS6.4 cap (20 calls) is one hard TOTAL model/provider-call budget covering synthetic rehearsal calls, the 12 real-item calls, AND any permitted retry -- no separate retry allowance, no second budget.
retry_scope.retry_conditions: At most ONE retry per call site, including after detector freeze, and only for (a) provider/transport failure or (b) malformed/non-parseable returned output. Never for an undesirable verdict, unexpected tag, weak-looking evidence, score impact, or a wanted second opinion.
retry_scope.retry_mechanics: A retry uses the identical frozen detector source, prompt/config, provider, model, input and retry policy. Every retry increments the same persisted call counter BEFORE invocation and is recorded in the transcript with its triggering failure.
retry_scope.pre_run_assertion_required: Before the 12-item blind run begins, assert at least 12 calls remain under the same cap. Otherwise STOP.
retry_scope.bookkeeping_note_1_of_2: Contract v2.1 is silent on retry treatment; operator ruled that all retries count inside the same SS6.4 cap.

source_unavailable.ruling: Confirmed as an execution/status convention introduced by the Validation A step, NOT vocabulary defined by contract v2.1. It is NOT a detector verdict, NOT a reason tag, NOT one of the nine SS6.1 tags. Its only role: mark an item whose original source cannot be resolved/reached while preserving that item's fixed positional slot.
source_unavailable.scoring_treatment: G1 denominator stays fixed at 12. A SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE item receives zero G1 agreement credit and zero G2 credit. Reported separately as a source-availability finding.
source_unavailable.implementation_requirement: Assert in code that SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE cannot be emitted as a detector verdict or reason tag.
source_unavailable.bookkeeping_note_2_of_2: SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE is a step-level source-status convention, not contract vocabulary.
